note: Natural Earth 1:10m Antarctic ice shelves, converted unchanged except coordinates rounded to 0.001 degree and repeated points dropped. Cartographic generalisation, not a glaciological survey: fronts are a fixed past position (calving since is not reflected) and small shelves are simplified. Good enough to stop a campaign route crossing a shelf face; replace with MEaSUREs (NSIDC-0709) or SCAR ADD for dated fronts.
